No major functional changes detected in this release.

- Minor metadata update: author changed to "chengzipi" in documentation.
- Removed default API endpoint information from the compatibility section.
- No changes to code or core functionality.

Bona Movie Production 1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Introduces image generation, image editing, and video generation capabilities using Nano Banana 2/Pro and Seedance/Kling models.
- Supports complex workflows such as multi-model image creation, high-quality commercial visuals, precise image editing, perspective transformation, and grid (3x3, 5x5) outputs.
- Includes detailed usage guides for each tool, model selection advice, and recommended prompt structures.
- Requires Python 3.9+ and a Bona API Key for API requests.
- Environment variable and dependency setup instructions provided.
